description_en: If an administrator enables O&M approval in a control policy, an O&M engineer must submit an O&M request and obtain administrator approval before logging on to an asset
description_zh: 如果管理员配置控制策略时开启了运维审批，则运维员登录资产时，需要申请运维且管理员审批通过后才能进行运维
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost accept-operation-ticket --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --operation-ticket-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AcceptOperationTicket

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host instance.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the O&M request to approve.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2584313.html operation to query all OperationTicketId values that require approval
parameters.help_zh:
需要允许的运维申请的ID。
您可以通过接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2584313.html查询所有需要审批的OperationTicketId
parameters.name: operation_ticket_id

parameters.help_en:
The limit on the number of logons allowed. Valid values:

0: No limit on the number of logons. The O&M engineer can log on an unlimited number of times during the validity period.

1: The O&M engineer can log on only once during the validity period.
The logon limit for database asset O&M approval can only be set to unlimited.
If an empty character string is passed, the default value is unlimited
parameters.help_zh:
允许登录的次数限制。取值：

0：不限制登录次数，运维员在有效期内可以无限次数登录。

1：运维员在有效期内只允许登录一次。
数据库资产运维审批的登录次数限制只能设置为不限制登录次数。 
传空字符串时默认为不限制登录次数
parameters.name: effect_count

parameters.help_en: The start time of the validity period for logon (in seconds, UNIX timestamp format)
parameters.help_zh: 允许登录的有效期开始时间（秒，时间戳格式）
parameters.name: effect_start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the validity period for logon (in seconds, UNIX timestamp format)
parameters.help_zh: 允许登录的有效期结束时间（秒，时间戳格式）
parameters.name: effect_end_time

RequestId.description_en: The unique identity generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
